placements.title: Perspective is the asset; substrate is the commodity
placements.theme: Owned intelligence retains perspective as the durable asset while treating substrate as interchangeable commodity, distinguishing it from rented intelligence where the substrate provider holds the perspective.
placements.why: src-1 asserts the core distinction between owned and rented intelligence; src-2 supplies the mechanism — substrate as commodity, perspective as the retained asset. Together they form a thematic claim about the nature of intelligence ownership that future envelopes can feed. The grain test admits this: it is a statement true beyond the words it describes, naming a subject future envelopes will keep contributing to. Nothing exists in the graph or strata to reuse.
